title: HuseInfinityBlogPost
description: Baseline content model for a 'Thoughts' post, used both to structure historical-post extraction and as the shape blog content will take in the new Next.js site (MDX frontmatter or CMS entry).

id.description: Stable internal identifier, independent of slug (slug may change; id should not). e.g. 'P001'.

slug.description: New URL slug on the rebuilt site, e.g. 'free-before-paid-technology-investment'.

legacyUrl.description: Original Wix URL, kept permanently for redirect mapping and audit trail.

publishDate.description: Original publish date (ISO 8601), preserved from Wix — do not reset on migration.

updatedDate.description: Date of last substantive content edit, if any. Null if never updated post-migration.

author.description: Reused across posts as a shared author object, not duplicated per post — supports author credibility/E-E-A-T pages.

slug.description: Links to author bio page, e.g. 'nelly-shen'.

categories.description: One or more categories from the proposed taxonomy (see Category Taxonomy tab). Kept as an array since Wix allowed multi-category tagging in practice.

tags.description: Free-form keyword tags, distinct from categories, for finer-grained internal linking and search.

contentPillar.description: Editorial/strategic pillar this post supports — used to track progress toward the thought-leadership goal, not shown publicly. Extend this enum as the content strategy develops.

povStrength.description: Internal editorial rating (1-5) of how strongly the post stakes out an original point of view vs. general summary — used to prioritize rewrites for posts aiming at opinion-leader positioning.

excerpt.description: Short teaser/dek shown on index pages, distinct from meta description.

alt.description: Descriptive alt text — many legacy Wix images lack this; write on extraction.

body.description: Full post content in Markdown/MDX. Preserve original paragraph structure and any embedded links during extraction.

internalLinks.description: Other posts/pages this post links to — used to preserve and later strengthen internal linking structure.

callToAction.description: Optional CTA block, e.g. linking to a downloadable resource or the newsletter.

noindex.description: Legacy site has at least one page incorrectly set to noindex — carry this flag explicitly so it's a deliberate decision, not an accident, on the new site.

status.description: Publication status on the new site.

migration.description: Tracking metadata for the migration project itself — not part of the public content model, strip before final CMS import if desired.

redirectFrom.description: Duplicate of legacyUrl for convenience in redirect-generation scripts.
